newsitem.title: USA: Enron Oil says it won Gulf of Mexico leases.
newsitem.headline: Enron Oil says it won Gulf of Mexico leases.

text.p: Enron Oil & Gas Co said Monday it was apparently the successful bidder, solely or with others, on a total of 22 tracts in a sale last week of western Gulf of Mexico oil and gas leases.

Assuming all bids are approved, the seven deepwater prospects (located in depths between 600 feet and 2,700 feet) and the 15 shelf blocks (located in depths of less than 600 feet) would represent expenditures net to Enron Oil of about $10.8 million.

The sale "includes our initial venture into higher potential deepwater play areas," the company said. "We hope to be drilling the first of the deepwater prospects within 18 months following final bid approval."
Enron Corp owns about 59 percent of Enron Oil & Gas.
